description: This file defines an abstract class 'BearerTokenIdentity' within the AWS SDK for PHP, representing an identity that uses Bearer Token credentials. It declares an abstract method 'getExpiration' to be implemented by subclasses, which returns the expiration timestamp of the token.

classes.name: BearerTokenIdentity
classes.description: An abstract class representing Bearer Token credentials identity, providing an interface for retrieving token expiration information.

methods.name: getExpiration
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the expiration timestamp of the Bearer Token. Returns null if no expiration is set.
